This is the JUKO KMP app. Always follow the strict MVVM + Clean Architecture rules defined in docs/coding_conventions.md. Always match UI designs against docs/stitch_screen_specs.md and use Juko* prefixed components from docs/component_library.md. Never put API calls in ViewModels. Never hardcode colors or spacing. Always use LocalSpacing.current and MaterialTheme.colorScheme. Always follow the UDF pattern with State, Event, and SideEffect.
